authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong structural integrity for electric guitars: correct Stratocaster silhouettes, functional components (pickups, bridges, 6 tuning pegs), and plausible materials. However, two artifact categories reduce authenticity: (1) Headstock logos are illegible gibberish rather than readable brand text—a severity 2 text artifact; (2) Spot textures show slight perspective flattening near body edges, indicating imperfect 3D volume mapping—severity 1 texture anomaly. The perceptual_quality_auditor reported no noise/blur/compression, confirming these are generation artifacts rather than post-processing defects. These issues prevent a perfect score but do not undermine overall recognizability.
key_defects: Minor spot texture perspective mapping anomalies (severity 1)

Harshness Bias: Ensured severity 1 texture anomaly did not disproportionately impact score; it compounds with severity 2 text issue but doesn't dominate. Final 4.0 reflects meaningful but non-critical flaws.
